papers.title: E089 Quantified-Chunk New-Post Cohort: Pre-registration with In-Flight Amendments (v1.2). Primary analysis re-scoped to P3; primary contribution a query-validity and namespace-drift taxonomy.
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: E089 is a pre-registered field study testing how generative AI search engines cite cold, newly published content. The study used 12 posts arranged as six topic-matched A/B pairs. One page in each pair opened with a quantified-chunk template: a front-loaded definition, named entities and at least one hard number already deposited in a public source. The other used the standard template. I checked citation and chunk reconstruction at D14 and D28 across Google Search, AI Overviews, AI Mode and Perplexity Sonar. This version finishes the analysis re-scope that began in amendment v1.1 and changes what the study can reasonably claim. V1.1 had already narrowed the confirmatory analysis from all six pairs to the two coined-term pillar pairs, P3 and P4. The informational half of the cohort failed query validity because the target queries hadn't been screened for search demand or namespace ownership, and every pair was compromised in a different way. P4 later collapsed too. Both arms were namespace-invalid, although for different reasons. That left P3 as the only primary pair. P3 produced a measurable negative result on the registered dependent variable: reconstruction of the engineered opening chunk. None of the four answer surfaces reproduced the treatment page's front-loaded statistic. They did, however, reproduce the plain declarative definition almost word for word on both arms. So the number being placed at the front wasn't what got the content selected. That result comes from one pair at one timepoint, with no D14 baseline and a sample below the minimum-N standard. I'm therefore reporting it as a directional negative, not as a confirmatory finding about the template. The study's primary contribution is now a taxonomy of query-validity failure and namespace drift. Five of the six pairs were compromised through different mechanisms: foreign-entity namespace capture, product-brand ownership, dense-corpus collision, authority saturation, topic-invalid queries and within-pair namespace asymmetry. This extends my earlier work on namespace drift. Two incidental extraction positives remain in the record. Two cold control pages, published without amplification, earned citations in AI Overviews and Perplexity with their engineered openings reproduced. One was still being cited in an off-protocol observation roughly three weeks after its last confirmed read. Nothing about the experiment itself has changed. Treatment assignments, the randomisation seed, publishing schedule, hygiene baseline, measurement offsets and coding rules remain as registered in v1.1. This version changes only the analysis and interpretation plan. Deposited under CC BY 4.0.

papers.title: The AI Citation Gap: How Brand Demand, Authority, and Knowledge Panels Decide Which of 1,000 US Personal Injury Law Firms AI Assistants Cite
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: When a US consumer asks an AI assistant a legal question, the assistant answers with a synthesized paragraph and a short list of named entities and cited pages. Which law firms appear in those answers, and whose web pages host the citations, is rapidly becoming the discoverability question of the decade for the personal injury (PI) vertical, where a single signed case can be worth six or seven figures and a single head-term click transacts for hundreds of dollars. This paper is the eighth in a series on entity-completeness signals in the top-ranking US PI vertical. It presents, to our knowledge, the first large-N per-assistant AI citation audit of the vertical: for the same 1,000 top-ranking US personal injury law firm sample used throughout the series, we join per-firm mention and cited-page counts across four AI answer surfaces (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview, and Google AI Mode) to the brand-search-demand, Person Entity Panel, Google Business Panel, domain-authority, and schema-completeness signals established in the prior papers. Three findings define what we name the AI Citation Gap. First, AI visibility is extremely concentrated: the median firm receives just 22 AI mentions across all four surfaces combined, the top 100 firms absorb 51.6% of all mentions, the bottom 500 firms share 9.6%, and the Gini coefficient of the mention distribution is 0.65. Second, the four assistants agree on who matters (pairwise Spearman rho = 0.70 to 0.88) but not symmetrically: 126 firms that are visible on Google's AI surfaces are completely absent from ChatGPT, while only 14 firms show the reverse pattern. Third, the citations are mostly not on the firm's own website. We introduce the Citation Intermediation Ratio (CIR), the share of a firm's AI citation footprint hosted by domains other than its own, and report a median CIR of 0.72: for the median firm, roughly 72% of its AI citations are hosted by third parties, with legal directories alone hosting 23%, and 99% of firms fall below 50% own-site share. Domain authority is the dominant correlate of AI mentions (rho = 0.80), brand search demand is the strongest firm-controllable second lever (firm brand rho = 0.44, significant in regression net of authority), the Person Entity Panel is citation-neutral, and the Google Business Panel is again associated with a citation deficit (median 19 vs 36 mentions, p < 0.001; OLS coefficient negative and significant), extending the zero-click cannibalization pattern documented in the Brand Demand Flywheel paper into the AI answer layer. An OLS model on log mentions reaches R-squared = 0.64. The paper closes with Citation Surface Optimization (CSO), a practitioner framework for managing owned versus rented AI citation surfaces.

papers.title: Measuring AI Visibility: A Method for Tracking Brand Mentions and Citations in LLM Answers
papers.abstract: Generative answer engines summarise rather than list, so a brand's presence in AI search is no longer a ranking position but a mention or a citation inside a generated answer. This report sets out a repeatable measurement method for that: how to assemble a buyer-prompt set, how to sample ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews across repeated runs, and how to score mention rate, citation rate, sentiment and share of voice against named competitors. It also discusses sampling variance, why single-run screenshots are not evidence, and what makes an AI visibility result reproducible. Published as a reference work by Suparank, a chat-first AI visibility and GEO platform: https://suparank.io/ . Author: Chase Allen, SEO/GEO Specialist. Contact: marketing@suparank.io

papers.title: CLINICAL PROTOCOL FOR PRECISION FERTILITY MANAGEMENT
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Протокол реалізує систему наскрізного прецизійного менеджменту клітинного потенціалу, що заміщує застарілі лінійні шаблони реактивного лікування безпліддя. Управління репродуктивним віком розвивається як безперервний, динамічний біологічний процес від пубертату до менопаузи з метою мінімізації алостатичного навантаження, оксидативної деструкції та системного ефекту (запального). Хронологічна матриця (6 етапів управління) ● Препубертатна та підліткова (Juvenile & Pediatric Repro-Aging): Ранній скринінг нейроендокринних дисфункцій, профілактика синдрому RED-S у молодому спорті, захист гонадного пулу від впливу токсичних чинників. ● Преконцепційна та регенеративна (Active Preconception Resilience): епігенетичне відновлення якості гамет, елімінація фрагментації ДНК сперматозоїдів, усунення станів низької доступності енергії (LEA). ● Тазова гармонізація (Endo-Pelvic Silence Stage): Придушення локального та системного запального каскаду для досягнення «тазової тиші» перед імплантацією. Цільова група: пацієнтки з аденоміозом, хворобливим тазовим болем та тяжкими формами ендометріозу. ● Екстрена онкопротекція (Oncofertility Preservation Window): Негайне збереження гонадного потенціалу шляхом застосування надшвидких протоколів кріоконсервації гамет і тканини до початку гонадотоксичної терапії. ● Гестаційний та перинатальний супровід (Epigenetic Gestational Care): Нейтралізація перинатальних ризиків (передні пологи, гестаційні кровотечі), спричинених метаболічною пам'яттю клітин про дефіцит енергії. ● Репро-антиейджинг та менопаузальна реверсія (Repro-Antiaging & Menopausal Transition): прецизійна органопротекція, відновлення мітохондріального біогенезу та підтримка ендотеліальної функції в періоді згасання гормональної активності для збереження соматичного здоров’я. papers.title: Technical AI-Discoverability Signals Among Agencies Identified Through Public AI-SEO Recommendation Sources
papers.abstract: A cross-sectional audit of 48 marketing agencies identified across seven public AI-SEO recommendation sources: six roundup articles and one Google AI Overview. Several of the roundup publishers included their own agencies, so inclusion is treated as sampling-frame membership rather than independent validation of expertise. Each agency website was measured on three layers: crawler-specific rules in robots.txt, publication of a Markdown-like llms.txt, and schema.org structured data exposed in the homepage's raw HTML. The study reuses the parsing and classification code from a previously published study of 1,629 general-population business websites, supporting a descriptive comparison with that historical cohort under disclosed differences in transport and collection time. This is an exploratory discovery study registered after data collection and analysis. It does not establish that AI-search specialization caused the observed adoption difference, nor does it measure whether any signal affects citation or recommendation by AI systems. The record includes a corrections log. Two eligible agencies were initially misclassified as unreachable because of a size limit in the author's fetcher. Several claims in an earlier draft were also withdrawn following an external LLM methodological review. Both the superseded and corrected datasets are included.
